wholePhysicalScope: Official Lands Department building polygon, published HKPD base and roof heights, the original local five-metre DTM, one exact cleared Qualla exterior photograph and AMO hall and restoration records.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the three halls, two open courtyards and entry colonnade.
limitations: The 2007 cleared photograph controls the original entry and roof proportions. The restoration facts and official terrain and height measurements set the standing model. The precise ridge relief and rear ornament use simplified geometry.
